name: smwgraphics-hammer-bro
title: Hammer Bro
description:
This is the *something* bro GFX from SMB3, but recolored to make it look like their current appearance.
I have also included an ExGFX file for the Fire Brother / Ice Brother sprites by NamelessProtagonist.

Also, if you use a *something* bro with palettes 8 or 9, use the included Palette file for them, their orange skins don't work with palettes 8 and 9.
You will have to modify the sprite's palette yourself though.
Palette 8 must be changed to Palette E.
Palette 9 must be changed to Palette F.
No credit needed. (this was really simple)
